name: Netorare Jidaigeki Sayo no Fugi
original_name: 寝取られ時代劇 小夜の不義
source:
A newly wedded low-ranked samurai and his wife was leading a happy life.
However, his beautiful wife is targeted by several other men.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065126.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一位地位低微的武士与妻子新婚燕尔，过着幸福的生活。
然而，几名其他男子却盯上了他美丽的妻子。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065126.html]DLsite English[/url]]
